script:
Script of the lights (lights): lighting: a light on or off at a person's word or a scene; off when its room has been vacant a while; a light suggested on entering an unlit room at night
- move light on: "I turn {L} on."; needs cmd light on(L), light dark(L), light ok(L) (kept); leaves light lit(L), done(on).
- move on already: "{L} is already on."; needs cmd light on(L), light lit(L) (kept); leaves refused(on).
- move on missing: "I can't turn {L} on: it does not answer."; needs cmd light on(L), light dark(L) (kept), light missing(L) (kept); leaves refused(on).
- move light off: "I turn {L} off."; needs cmd light off(L), light lit(L), light ok(L) (kept); leaves light dark(L), done(off).
- move off already: "{L} is already off."; needs cmd light off(L), light dark(L) (kept); leaves refused(off).
- move off missing: "I can't turn {L} off: it does not answer."; needs cmd light off(L), light lit(L) (kept), light missing(L) (kept); leaves refused(off).
- move on unknown: "I can't: there is no such light in this home."; needs cmd light on(lx); leaves refused(on).
- move off unknown: "I can't: there is no such light in this home."; needs cmd light off(lx); leaves refused(off).
- move sweep off: "I turn {L} off for the scene."; needs sweep off(L), light lit(L), light ok(L) (kept); leaves light dark(L), switched(L).
- move sweep kept: "{L} was already off."; needs sweep off(L), light dark(L) (kept); leaves kept(L).
- move sweep missed: "I could not turn {L} off: it does not answer."; needs sweep off(L), light lit(L) (kept), light missing(L) (kept); leaves missed(L).
- move vacant off: "Nobody has been in {R} for a while: I turn {L} off."; needs vacant(R) (kept), light in(L,R), light lit(L), light ok(L) (kept); leaves light dark(L), auto off(L).
- move welcome dark: "You came into {R} and it is dark: shall I turn the light on?"; needs entered(R), night (kept), room unlit(R) (kept); leaves suggest light(R).
- things it counts: occupied; empty; vacant; unsensed; someone home; nobody home; home unsensed; day; night; running; stopped; heater on; heater off; unit ok; unit missing; entered; left home; came home; dawn; light lit; light dark; light ok; light missing; room lit; room unlit; cmd light on; cmd light off; sweep off; done; refused; switched; kept; missed; auto off; suggest light
